steps.player: What's going on here? Where is everyone?

steps.npc: Most are in the city. As for the rest, hopefully somewhere nicer than this place.
Yes. When we heard they were going to lock Menaphos down and shut the gates, most people here decided they'd be better off behind the walls than outside them.
We didn't get much warning. People had to rush to gather whatever they could. Some things had to be left behind, along with some people...
It could have been worse. Had we been in Sophanem, we'd have had no warning at all. I just hope it won't be long before things are back to normal.
Thank you, traveller. Stay safe out there. These are troubling times.
